result.excerpt: f Section 953(b) of the Dodd-Frank Act and Item 402(u) of Regulation S-K (which we collectively refer to as the Pay Ratio Rule), we are providing the following estimated information for 2025: • the median of the annual total compensation of all our employees (except our Chief Executive Officer) was $61,430; • the annual total compensation of our Chief Executive Officer was $15,435,220; and • the ratio of these two amounts was 251 to 1. We believe that this ratio is a reasonable estimate calculated in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Pay Ratio Rule.
